image_description: A dark purple or black golf cart parked on a grassy area with trees in the background. The cart features a beige fabric canopy, two beige bucket-style seats, a steering wheel, and a visible side mirror. It has small wheels with chrome hubcaps and turf tires. There is a white decal or logo on the side panel near the rear.
